'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears with [[Qiansu]] in {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Huaiqian:''' Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?

==Dialogue==
;During {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}.
:'''Huaiqian:''' Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
:'''Qiansu:''' All accounted for... I still cannot wrap my head around it. I saw my own work—the transmission lever I just fixed.
:'''Huaiqian:''' Keep a close watch on them. We will need to give an account for this later.
:'''Qiansu:''' To others... and to ourselves.
{{Dialogue End}}
